name: Zeresh (Haman's wife)
title: Haman's advisor
summary: Zeresh was the wife of Haman, the powerful official under King Ahasuerus of Persia. She advised her husband on how to take revenge against Mordecai but also prophetically warned him of his impending downfall when she learned that Mordecai was a Jew.

keyEvents.title: Advice about the gallows
keyEvents.description: When Haman came home full of rage over Mordecai, who refused to bow down, Zeresh and his friends suggested that he build a gallows fifty cubits high and ask the king to hang Mordecai on it.

keyEvents.title: Prophetic warning
keyEvents.description: After Haman was forced to honor Mordecai publicly, Zeresh and his advisors warned him that if Mordecai was of Jewish descent, Haman would not prevail against him but would surely fall.

keyEvents.title: Witness to Haman's humiliation
keyEvents.description: Zeresh was among those who heard Haman's account of how he had to lead Mordecai through the city on the king's horse and proclaim his honor.
